items.title: Lawrence Duhé Interview, 1960
items.q: Mr. Deer, when you were in the Warriors, did you happen to meet Buddy Bolger? I'm sure he must have run into him. Oh, yes.

ctx.x: Mr. Deer, we'd like for you to tell us, for instance, when these white musicians picked up jazz from the Cullen Boys.

Well, they used to come to those places nightly, and they got them so good so they'd say, Well, Deer, you want to take a walk around the block? I said, Yes. Go ahead. I'll rest you up. I'll play clarinet. And so the rest of the instruments, the other boys would rest them up like that. That's the way they started. Mr. Deer, when you were in the Warriors, did you happen to meet Buddy Bolger? I'm sure he must have run into him. Oh, yes. And New Orleans knows about him.
